 Share: Judge sides with ACA brokers, lifts moratorium on new registrations
 Healthcare DIVE November 6, 2026 
 Jill Hughes 
 A federal judge agreed with brokers’ arguments that the freeze, instituted by the CMS to combat fraud on the exchanges, would cause irreparable harm to agents.
 A Maryland district court struck down the CMS’ moratorium on new brokers in the Affordable Care Act exchanges on Thursday, arguing the trade associations that sued would be likely to succeed should the litigation continue.
 The ruling paves the way for new agents and brokers to begin training on Friday and participate in open enrollment, which started this week and ends in mid-January.
